<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v2/domains/{domain}/inboxes/{inbox}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns messages for a specific inbox. To fetch SMS messages, provide the team-assigned SMS phone number as the inbox value.
